tweet.text:
Don't look at swarm-forge as a drop-in product that you can use.  Look at it (and the many other harnesses out there) as templates that you can customize to your particular needs.

One of the great powers of AI agents is that you can point them at an existing project and tell them to create something like it, but with a bunch of exceptions and differences.  In the end you wind up with something tuned to you, not to me.
